bio: The intimate Sequenza has won a place in the hearts of its many regulars, with a multi-course set menu rightly appreciated for its distinctive and at times inventive take on classic French cuisine. The chef's choice of top-tier ingredients reflects a deep command of the craft. Red mullet fillet with cherry tomatoes, jalapeño, crushed macadamia nuts, melon balls, a rich crab bisque emulsion and an indulgent hollandaise sauce with shaved tonka bean for a touch of spice – a dish that's likely to steal your heart, too....
